subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should public `after_compaction` hooks receive `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` while raw lifecycle reset queues remain available only to the branded built-in harness and registered bundled Codex/Copilot harness objects?
rationale: The branch creates both a public plugin capability and a private authority exception across session and harness ownership boundaries; repository behavior and tests can validate an implementation, but they cannot choose the permanent trust contract.

options.title: Approve the narrow host-owned contract
options.body: Keep the scoped hook method, require host-owned canonical-key queues, document its conditional availability, remove unrelated changes, and prohibit raw authority for external harnesses.

options.title: Use a declarative hook outcome
options.body: Have `after_compaction` return a typed reset request that the lifecycle owner validates and executes, avoiding callback authority in harness parameters.

options.title: Do not expose plugin resets
options.body: Keep session rotation internal to core and owner plugins until a broader plugin session-lifecycle API is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow host-owned contract
recommendation.body: Keep the scoped hook method, require host-owned canonical-key queues, document its conditional availability, remove unrelated changes, and prohibit raw authority for external harnesses.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history covers the affected harness, gateway reset, and database compatibility boundaries, including the explicit schema-11 decision.
